FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Greenway Shopping Plaza operates as a community-focused retail center that offers a diverse mix of low to moderate-risk tenant businesses, primarily consisting of professional offices, boutique retail stores, and service-oriented establishments. We emphasize a tenant roster that includes established pharmacies, local coffee shops, and family-owned boutiques, fostering a stable environment that attracts foot traffic and enhances customer experiences. Our property is managed with meticulous attention to safety and compliance, prioritizing up-to-date fire suppression systems and security measures to mitigate risks effectively. Regular maintenance schedules are established to uphold the property’s condition, while inspections ensure adherence to all local safety regulations and codes. We have a clear commitment to risk management and have enjoyed a clean claims history, contributing to our goals of maintaining a safe shopping experience for our customers and tenants alike.

Our shopping center features a diverse array of tenants, including a popular nightclub, a lively bar, and a cannabis dispensary, all of which contribute to the vibrant atmosphere and foot traffic in the area.
